name: aeg-d-xcop
title: X-COP galaxy clusters: observed and baryonic accelerations as released by Eckert et al. 2022
description: Atlas conversion of the accelerations released with Eckert et al. 2022 (A&A 662, A123) under data standard 2.5.1 (D-089, D-090): g_obs from the source's non-parametric hydrostatic reconstruction and g_bar from its gas, central-galaxy and satellite masses, both as released, at the radii of the data, for the five clusters with stellar data (109 radii). The seven other X-COP clusters are listed and recorded, not plotted (no stellar mass in the source). Values differ from v1 by ruling (D-090). Built under the frozen tests REPRODUCTION.md (part A) and REPRODUCTION_PART_B.md and the frozen second reading in reading/. Not published until the authors confirm (D-090 rule 5).
x_publication_notice: Version 2, built from Eckert et al. 2022, is ready and awaiting the authors' confirmation.
x_licence_status: No licence stated by the source; asked (#19). The two archives shared by D. Eckert are fetched at build time, verified by hash and never redistributed (D-004). Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the source, once the authors confirm (D-090 rule 5).

sources.title: Eckert, Ettori, Pointecouteau, van der Burg & Loubser 2022, A&A 662, A123 (arXiv 2205.01110v1)
Eckert et al. 2022 data archives data_E22.tar.gz and mbar.tar.gz, shared by D. Eckert on 2026-11-03 (not redistributed)

x_citation: Eckert, D., Ettori, S., Pointecouteau, E., van der Burg, R. F. J. & Loubser, S. I. 2022, A&A 662, A123 (arXiv 2205.01110): g_obs and g_bar. The programme behind the inputs: Ettori et al. 2019 (arXiv 1805.00035; A&A 621, A39), hydrostatic masses; Eckert et al. 2019 (arXiv 1805.00034), gas; Loubser et al. 2020 (arXiv 2006.05706), central galaxies; Ghizzardi et al. 2021 (arXiv 2007.01084), satellite stellar masses. Uncertainty terms also cite Eckert et al. 2022b, A&A 666, A41 (arXiv 2205.01123) and Ettori & Eckert 2022 (arXiv 2112.07554).
